titleEn: He Who Is Absent Is Always in the Wrong

items.promptEn: While Ka was on leave, the team blamed her for a late report without checking the record.
items.promptZh: 會議時嘉嘉請假，組員未查紀錄便把遲交報告歸咎於她。

options.text: The team blamed Ka before hearing her account—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 未聽她解釋便怪責，符合諺語的警告。

options.text: Ka admitted that she had delayed the report—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 原文沒有嘉嘉承認的事實。

options.text: The team waited to hear Ka before deciding—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 組員沒有等她說明。

options.text: Ka’s absence proved she had caused the delay—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 缺席不能證明造成延誤。

items.promptEn: A gym key went missing, and the only employee absent from the meeting was immediately suspected.
items.promptZh: 健身室鑰匙失蹤，唯一不在場的職員立即被懷疑。

options.text: The absent employee was suspected before being heard—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 懷疑來自無法在場回應，不等於證實。

options.text: The absent employee was caught taking the key—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 沒有目擊偷鑰匙。

options.text: The employee was present and explained everything—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 員工當時缺席。

options.text: The missing key was found in the employee’s bag—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 沒有從袋中找到鑰匙的資料。

items.promptEn: After the team lost, the captain missed the review meeting and others said it was all his fault.
items.promptZh: 校隊敗了，隊長不在檢討會上，眾人便說全是他的錯。

options.text: The team assigned blame to the absent captain without his response—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 隊長缺席，仍被單方面判全責。

options.text: The captain accepted sole responsibility at the meeting—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 他沒出席，也未承認責任。

options.text: The group heard the captain and shared responsibility—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 眾人沒有聽隊長說法。

options.text: The loss proves that captains are always to blame—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 一次失敗不能證明隊長永遠有錯。

items.promptEn: An audio file was damaged; the absent technician was blamed before anyone inspected it.
items.promptZh: 錄音檔損壞後，不在場的技術員被怪責，雖然檔案尚未檢查。

options.text: The technician was blamed before the file was inspected or he could reply—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 責任未查明，缺席者卻先被責怪。

options.text: The technician confessed to deleting the file—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 題目沒有技術員承認。

options.text: The file was inspected and cleared the technician—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 尚未檢查檔案。

options.text: The damaged file alone proved who caused it—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 檔案損壞不能單獨指明責任人。

items.promptEn: When supplies ran out, staff blamed the buyer who was on holiday without checking the orders.
items.promptZh: 餐廳缺貨時，休假的採購員被指責，其他人卻未查看訂單。

options.text: Staff blamed the buyer before checking the orders or hearing from her—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 先怪責休假者，未核對訂單。

options.text: The buyer had admitted forgetting the order—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 沒有承認漏訂。

options.text: Staff checked the order and found a delivery fault—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 原文說沒有查看訂單。

options.text: The holiday itself caused the shortage—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 請假本身不能證明缺貨原因。

items.promptEn: After a display fell, the absent designer was blamed; nobody asked who moved it.
items.promptZh: 展板跌倒後，缺席的設計師被怪責；沒人問當時是誰把展板移位。

options.text: The absent designer was blamed before anyone checked who moved the display—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 關鍵移位者未查，設計師又不在場。

options.text: The designer was seen moving the display—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 沒有人看到設計師移位。

options.text: The group asked everyone involved before deciding—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 原文說沒人查問。

options.text: The fall proved the design was faulty—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 跌倒不能單獨證明設計有問題。

items.promptEn: A wrong notice was sent; an offline moderator was blamed before the other moderators checked the log.
items.promptZh: 群組誤發通知，沒有上線的管理員被責怪，其他管理員尚未查記錄。

options.text: The offline moderator took the blame before anyone checked the log—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 未查紀錄就怪責無法即時回應的人。

options.text: The log already showed that the moderator sent it—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 紀錄尚未檢查。

options.text: Every moderator had been asked for an explanation—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 沒有問遍所有管理員。

options.text: Being offline is proof of sending the notice—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 離線與發送通知沒有必然關係。

items.promptEn: Bin missed a family discussion, and relatives said he caused all the moving trouble.
items.promptZh: 阿彬缺席家庭討論，親戚便說搬家的麻煩都是他造成。

options.text: Relatives blamed Bin while he was not there to tell his side—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 阿彬沒有機會回應，已被推責。

options.text: Bin explained and accepted all responsibility—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 他未在場解釋。

options.text: Relatives delayed judgment until Bin returned—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 親戚沒有等他回來。

options.text: A missed discussion proves that Bin arranged the move badly—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 缺席不證明搬遷安排有問題。

items.promptEn: A box of books was missing; a volunteer absent from stocktake was blamed before loan records were checked.
items.promptZh: 圖書館遺失一箱書，缺席點算的義工先被責怪，借還記錄仍未查。

options.text: The volunteer was blamed without being heard or checking the loans—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 先責怪缺席者，借還紀錄卻未查。

options.text: The volunteer was caught taking the box—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 沒有抓到義工取書。

options.text: The loan records had already settled the question—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 原文說紀錄仍未查。

options.text: The absence made the books disappear—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 缺席不會造成書本憑空消失。

items.promptEn: Trip photos vanished, and a friend who missed the discussion was accused of deleting them.
items.promptZh: 旅行照片不見了，沒有參加討論的朋友被指刪除檔案。

options.text: The friend was accused while unable to answer the group—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 缺席者被指責，尚未有其說法。

options.text: The friend confirmed deleting the photos—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 沒有朋友承認。

options.text: The group checked the backup before accusing anyone—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 題目沒有先查備份。

options.text: Missing the discussion proves who deleted the files—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 缺席不能證明刪檔。

items.promptEn: A decision drew complaints, and the former chair absent from a new meeting was treated as solely responsible.
items.promptZh: 一項決定引起投訴，沒有出席新會議的舊主席被當作唯一責任人。

options.text: The absent former chair was blamed before the group examined who made the decision—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 沒有核對決策過程便把責任推給缺席者。

options.text: The former chair stated that he alone made the decision—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 沒有主席承認獨自決定。

options.text: The group checked the minutes before assigning blame—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 原文未說先查會議紀錄。

options.text: Complaints prove that the absent chair alone was wrong—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 投訴不證明唯一責任人。

items.promptEn: A rehearsal time changed; the ill choreographer was blamed without anyone calling to check with her.
items.promptZh: 排演時間被改，正在生病的編舞者被怪責，但沒有人打電話向她核實。

options.text: The choreographer was blamed while unable to offer her account—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 她不在場且未獲查問，卻被責怪。

options.text: The choreographer confirmed changing the time—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 她未確認改時間。

options.text: The cast called and heard her explanation first—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 原文說沒有人致電。

options.text: Illness proves that she made the change—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
options.reasonZh: 生病不是改時間的證據。

meaning.zh: 某人不在場、不能說明自己的立場時，其他人容易把錯推到他身上。
meaning.en: An absent person may be blamed unfairly because they cannot present their side.

model.zh: 開會時阿傑不在，大家便把延誤歸咎於他，卻沒有人核對紀錄。
model.en: Jay missed the meeting, and the group blamed him for the delay without checking the record—he who is absent is always in the wrong.

picture.zh: 想像一張空椅子：旁人都在發言，椅子的主人無法回應。
picture.en: Picture an empty chair while everyone else speaks; its owner cannot answer back.

boundary.zh: 諺語描述被指責的處境，不證明缺席者真的犯錯。
boundary.en: The proverb describes an unfair advantage for those present; it does not prove the absent person guilty.

where.zh: 適合提醒團隊先聽缺席者的說法，再決定責任。
where.en: Use it to urge a group to hear the absent person before assigning blame.

tone.zh: 常帶批評或警惕意味，並非替所有缺席者開脫。
tone.en: Often critical or cautionary; it does not excuse every absent person.

checks.zh: 責任是證實了，還是被推定？
我有沒有先核對另一方說法？
checks.en: Have I checked the other side?

readAloud.zh: 不要因為安妮今天請假，就把遺失的文件算在她頭上。
readAloud.en: Let’s hear Annie’s account before blaming her for the missing file—he who is absent is always in the wrong.

prompt.zh: 哪個情境顯示缺席者容易被錯怪？
prompt.en: Which scene shows the risk described by the proverb?

options.zh: 會議只聽到一方說法，就指責了請假的同事。
options.en: A meeting blames a colleague who is on leave after hearing only one side.
options.reasonZh: 缺席者無法回應，責任卻已被分配。

options.zh: 同事在場承認自己弄丟了文件。
options.en: The colleague is present and admits losing the file.
options.reasonZh: 這是當面承認，不是因缺席而被推責。

options.zh: 會議延後結論，等待請假的同事說明。
options.en: The meeting postpones its conclusion until the absent colleague can speak.
options.reasonZh: 團隊避免了諺語所警告的偏差。

prompt.zh: 有人指責不在場的同學，你應如何回應？
prompt.en: Someone blames an absent classmate. How should you respond?

options.zh: 「先聽他說明，別只憑一方說法定責。」
options.en: “Let’s hear his account before deciding who was responsible.”
options.reasonZh: 讓缺席者有機會說明。

options.zh: 「他不在場，所以一定是他做錯。」
options.en: “He is absent, so he must be at fault.”
options.reasonZh: 把不能自辯誤當作犯錯證據。

options.zh: 「他不在場，所以一定完全無辜。」
options.en: “He is absent, so he must be completely innocent.”
options.reasonZh: 諺語也不能證明無辜。

prompt.zh: 報告出錯時，唯一缺席的編輯立即被怪責。哪句最貼切？
prompt.en: The only absent editor is immediately blamed for an error. Which line fits?

options.zh: 「先別急著怪責她；人不在場，最容易被說成有錯。」
options.en: “Let’s not blame her before checking—he who is absent is always in the wrong.”
options.reasonZh: 用諺語提醒大家不要作單方面判斷。

options.zh: 「她已承認出錯；人不在場，最容易被說成有錯。」
options.en: “She has admitted the error—he who is absent is always in the wrong.”
options.reasonZh: 題目沒有說她承認出錯。

options.zh: 「我們已聽過她的解釋；人不在場，最容易被說成有錯。」
options.en: “We have heard her explanation—he who is absent is always in the wrong.”
options.reasonZh: 她尚未有機會回應。

options.zh: 「缺席的人可能遭到不公平指責；仍須查證事實。」
options.en: “An absent person may be blamed unfairly; the facts still need checking.”
options.reasonZh: 區分被指責與真正有錯。

options.zh: 「被指責就證明缺席的人有罪。」
options.en: “Being blamed proves that the absent person was guilty.”
options.reasonZh: 指責本身不是證據。
諺語沒有這種保證。
